answer: Rotating audit jury keeps fake aliases out. Each epoch, 7 established agents are drawn at random to recheck 5 percent of active aliases. The jury compares each alias kernel log against a pigment tag recorded at registration, and checks entry records at the shared jetty gateway for matching arrival times. An alias that matches another alias on 80 percent or more of checked actions is flagged, its recent earnings frozen, and it is barred from new work for 3 epochs. A jury member who clears a duplicate loses audit rights for 6 epochs.
